corner the market: By buying up most of the small farms, the company hoped to corner the market for organic tea.
藉由買下大部分的小農場，這家公司希望壟斷有機茶的市場。
be cornered: The thief was cornered in a dark alley by two police officers and had no way to escape.
小偷在一條暗巷裡被兩名警察逼到絕境，無路可逃。
corner someone: Reporters tried to corner the singer at the back door, trapping her with questions about her secret wedding.
記者們試圖在後門把那位歌手逼到角落，用她祕密婚禮的問題圍住她。
cut corners: The builders cut corners by using cheap materials, so the bridge started to crack after only two years.
建商使用便宜的材料偷工減料，所以這座橋才兩年就開始出現裂縫。
correspond to the facts: The witness's story did not correspond to the facts shown in the security camera video.
證人的說詞與監視器影片中呈現的事實不相符。
correspond with a pen pal: When I was in junior high, I used to correspond with a pen pal in Canada by sending letters every month.
我國中時常和加拿大的一位筆友通信，每個月都寄信。
correspond closely: The results of the two experiments correspond closely, so the scientists are confident their theory is correct.
兩次實驗的結果十分一致，所以科學家們對他們的理論很有信心。
corrupt officials: The new mayor promised to punish corrupt officials who had taken money from construction companies.
新市長承諾要懲罰收受建設公司金錢的腐敗官員。
corrupt the youth: Some parents worry that violent video games may corrupt the youth and make them less kind to others.
有些家長擔心暴力電玩可能會帶壞年輕人，讓他們對別人不那麼友善。
corrupt a file: A computer virus can corrupt a file so badly that you will never be able to open it again.
電腦病毒可能把檔案損壞得非常嚴重，讓你再也打不開它。
absolute power corrupts: History shows that absolute power corrupts, because leaders who face no checks often become cruel and greedy.
歷史證明絕對權力使人腐化，因為不受制衡的領導者往往變得殘暴又貪婪。
counsel patience: Doctors usually counsel patience, explaining that a broken leg needs at least two months to heal properly.
醫生通常會勸人耐心，解釋骨折的腿至少需要兩個月才能好好癒合。
counsel students: Mrs. Lin's job is to counsel students who feel confused about choosing a university major.
林老師的工作是輔導對選擇大學科系感到困惑的學生。
counsel against action: Since the storm was getting worse, the experts chose to counsel against action until the weather improved.
由於暴風雨越來越強，專家們選擇勸阻採取行動，直到天氣好轉。
counter the argument: During the debate, Ann used clear statistics to counter the argument that homework always improves grades.
辯論時，安用清楚的統計數字來反駁「作業總能提升成績」的論點。
counter the threat: The government sent more ships to the coast to counter the threat of illegal fishing boats.
政府派更多船艦到海岸，以反制非法漁船的威脅。
counter the effects: Drinking plenty of water can help counter the effects of the hot sun during a long hike.
長途健行時，多喝水有助於抵銷烈日的影響。
run counter to: Eating fried food every day would run counter to your goal of losing weight before summer.
每天吃炸物會與你在夏天前減重的目標背道而馳。
court danger: Hikers who ignore the warning signs and climb the cliff alone are simply courting danger.
無視警告標誌、獨自攀爬懸崖的登山客根本是自找危險。
court disaster: Driving fast on mountain roads during a typhoon is a sure way to court disaster.
颱風天在山路上開快車，肯定會招致災難。
court voters: Before the election, both candidates visited night markets to court voters and shake hands with them.
選舉前，兩位候選人都去夜市拉攏選民並和他們握手。
court controversy: The famous director likes to court controversy by making films about topics most people avoid.
這位知名導演喜歡拍大多數人迴避的題材來惹來爭議。
cover the cost: My part-time job barely pays enough to cover the cost of my bus tickets and lunches.
我的打工薪水幾乎不夠支付我的公車票和午餐費用。
cover the news: Dozens of reporters rushed to the airport to cover the news of the president's arrival.
數十名記者趕到機場報導總統抵達的新聞。
cover a distance: The runners must cover a distance of 42 kilometers to finish the marathon.
跑者必須跑完42公里的距離才能完成馬拉松。
cover a topic: The final exam will cover a topic from every chapter we studied this semester, so review all your notes.
期末考會涵蓋這學期讀過每一章的主題，所以要複習所有筆記。
cover for a colleague: Mia lied to the manager to cover for a colleague who had overslept and missed the morning meeting.
米亞向經理撒謊，替睡過頭錯過晨會的同事掩護（代班）。
cover up a scandal: The company tried to cover up a scandal about unsafe food, but a worker told the newspapers.
公司試圖掩蓋一樁不安全食品的醜聞，但一名員工向報社爆料了。
